title: FilterDirect Shipment Charges, Discounts and Shipping
content:
**Charging rule for FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions.** A shipment leaves the warehouse on the 5th day of the month in each cycle, the cycle being the grade's months between shipments, and contains the grade's filters per shipment. It is charged on the ship date. The shipment charge is the grade's filters per shipment multiplied by the grade's price per filter, plus the grade's custom-size surcharge for each filter when the subscribed size is not on the grade's standard size list.

**Discounts.** The first shipment of a new subscription is reduced by 20 percent. A subscriber holding an active Comfort Club agreement on the ship date receives 10 percent off the shipment charge, posted as a member filter discount. The first-shipment discount and the member discount never stack: the larger of the two applies.

**Shipping.** Shipping is free when the combined shipment charge is at least $35.00; otherwise the shipping fee of $5.99 is charged.

**Activation.** A subscription is pending from sign-up until its first shipment leaves; a pending subscription becomes active when its first shipment leaves the warehouse and is charged.

| Grade | Ship day | First-shipment discount | Member discount |
|---|---|---|---|
| FilterDirect Standard MERV 8 | 5th | 20% | 10% |
| FilterDirect Pleated MERV 11 | 5th | 20% | 10% |
| FilterDirect Allergen MERV 13 | 5th | 20% | 10% |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 11 | 5th | 20% | 10% |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 13 | 5th | 20% | 10% |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 16 | 5th | 20% | 10% |

### Membership as the records show it

The member discount rests on the Comfort Club agreement held by the same customer as the subscription, with its status in the company's records active on the ship date. The subscriber's own statement of membership is not the basis.

### Which discount applies

| First shipment of a new subscription? | Active Comfort Club agreement on the ship date? | Discount on that shipment |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 20% first-shipment discount (the larger; the member discount is not added) |
| Yes | No | 20% first-shipment discount |
| No | Yes | 10% member discount |
| No | No | Neither of these discounts |

Because 20 percent is larger than 10 percent for every grade, a first shipment never carries both.

### Worked examples (hypothetical prices and sizes)

1. *Later shipment, member, stocked size.* A hypothetical grade ships 2 filters at $40.00 each. The shipment charge is 2 multiplied by $40.00, or $80.00. The subscriber's Comfort Club agreement is active on the ship date, so the member filter discount is 10 percent of $80.00, or $8.00. The shipment charge of $80.00 is at least $35.00, so shipping is free.
2. *First shipment, member, stocked size.* A hypothetical grade ships 2 filters at $15.00 each, a shipment charge of $30.00. The 20 percent first-shipment discount ($6.00) is larger than the 10 percent member discount ($3.00), so only the $6.00 first-shipment discount applies. With no other shipment of the customer leaving that date, the combined shipment charge is $30.00, below $35.00, so the shipping fee of $5.99 is charged.
3. *Later shipment, non-member, size not on the list.* A hypothetical grade ships 1 filter at $50.00 with a hypothetical custom-size surcharge of $10.00 per filter. The shipment charge is $50.00 plus $10.00, or $60.00; no discount applies, and shipping is free.
